list: the official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18
notes: Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources. Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method in any community guide at launch (19 Nov 2026) and are marked unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Expect the road to take around 200 hours: 60 to 80 hours of story across five chapters, then roughly 100 hours on the 100% checklist and the last cleanup. Nothing on the list is missable except possibly the first meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude), so play the story first, keep a save at the start and end of each chapter, and clean up in free-roam afterwards.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1. Just play the story and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — in practice that is when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: it is the one thing in the chapter that may not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, gets going. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: the Coffee Break mission unlocks playing as both Jason and Lucia, which most partner trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops once Chapter 3 is done, after the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). Chapter 3 unlocks the systems behind several other trophies — the Snap Gun and jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner, and the Dye Pack Jammer — so do the side questlines as they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 also opens the large bank vault robberies through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which feeds Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish the story's final mission and it pops at the credits. One wording note — the trophy lists agree the final mission sits in Chapter 5, while PowerPyx's table repeats the Chapter 4 finale name for this entry, which clashes with its own Chapter 5 entry for Snow Storm. Treat the mission name as unconfirmed and just play to the end of the story.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. No preparation needed — play the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission through and it pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Just play the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, the airport job. Play it through and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the last story trophies before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the backbone of the platinum. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts. The requirements are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion. You need any 100 optional missions (there are 200 to 300+), 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, every robbery, every shooting range, every drone race and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Nothing toward 100% is missable and everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Do optional missions as they appear — they introduce new systems — scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study every new animal as you go.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100% checklist)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the four types however you like — flying under bridges is the quickest to grind. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. The tracker counts them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will be introduced to most types by the story and the rest appear as you unfog the map — while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist you will do one of each without trying.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. The gold thresholds are lenient and the ranges are also how you raise your Focus level, which Gunslinger needs. Work through the ranges after the story when your weapons and Focus are levelled — PowerPyx's companion guide maps all 12 locations and all 42 gold medals.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, three per location. You only need one win per location, not all 42, but the 100% checklist wants every drone race, so winning them all as you go saves a second pass. PowerPyx's companion guide maps all 14 locations.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 14 Top Fun Drone Race Locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct ones out of the 40 unique race locations. Street races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the win, and the same races feed the 100% checklist's race requirements. PowerPyx's companion guide maps all 40 unique race locations.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 40 Unique Race Locations

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge. The questline unlocks early, so do it when the text arrives rather than leaving it for the cleanup.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can do this from Chapter 1 — and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once; beating every challenge is not required. Pick whichever game you like best.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 4 Video Game Locations

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: at some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address in Belville. All five quests stay available after the story: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). Finish the last one and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving at shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. After the first set he calls you back for more — seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2 to 3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds his text up), so he is not missable. Track him under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All five quests stay available after the story: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. Finish the last job with Billy and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but only certain questlines count, and the game does not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward this trophy even though they look like strangers. Strands confirmed to count: Kirk (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries at Southpoint Airfield and Avery Allen & Co., plus Deliver Packages). More counting strangers were still being discovered at launch — watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count, and do the strands in free-roam after the story if any are left.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All Strangers & Freaks

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City): the Zorrusso from the story plus the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. He marks some cars for you in fixed spots and marks new ones as you complete them; you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app (hold Up) to see if it is on the list, then drive it back, in good condition for a better payout. Sports cars are common in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, often parked outside hotels. Track the list under Map, then Robberies (money bag icon), then Randy's Wish List. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you at the Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Destroy enough labs and Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finish it and the trophy pops. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT CAN BE MISSED. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1. In the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen — she says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, and when the optional quest pops up, talk to her on the balcony and choose Accept; she shows you how to meditate. It raises the counter by 1 in the Progress menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy actually requires it — PowerPyx earned the trophy having done it, and recommends doing it to be safe. The final meditation cannot be done until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the morning it appears, keep a manual save from Chapter 1, and finish the other 17 spots in free-roam.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 18 Meditation Spot Locations

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do it and he marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him as Jason. His first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation; one clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities (dumbbell icon), then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — PowerPyx's companion guide maps all 18 card set locations, so pick the three sets whose cards sit closest together and sweep them in one drive. Card sets are a pure collectible hunt with no story gate, so they are ideal free-roam cleanup after the story.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 18 Collectible Card Set Locations

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations: hold Up to open the WAiNK app, look at a scannable object and hold R1. There are well over 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures among them — so it does not matter which 100 you scan. The habit to build is scanning everything as you travel: it also feeds Whip It Good, since vehicles scan the same way, and the 100% checklist's vehicle requirement.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You only need 50 for the trophy and 70 for the 100% checklist, so there are 10 to 30 you can skip — pick the easiest. Track them under Progress, then Challenges, where a checkmark shows what is done. Most complete themselves while you work on the other trophies; leave this for one of your last trophies, then look at what is left and knock out the quickest ones. PowerPyx's companion guide lists all 80 challenges.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 80 Challenges Guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Then build a 4-star wanted level (cause carnage until you hit four stars) and escape the red heat zone on the map, not just the flashing blue-red search area. The easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. If you would rather not force it, it comes automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing the large bank vaults always triggers a 4-star wanted level you must escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, with your partner beside you (hold Right, press Triangle to call them), rob 3 robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Keep the red-blue flashing wanted level; do not let it drop to nothing and do not let it rise into the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if you leave the first store before the police arrive you may need a fourth store. The pop is delayed — it comes about half a minute after you leave the third shop — so keep robbing until it unlocks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The game has 557 vehicles at launch and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes automatically if you scan from the start. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus: while aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to slow time and highlight enemies' vulnerable spots. Focus drains fast, so prepare first — eat or drink to buff focus, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow-time window. Then line up five enemies and drop them quickly without missing. Gang-operation criminals are the best targets; it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for full-auto accuracy and wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. Focus has four levels (Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Focus) raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — it gets much easier late in the game, and you may earn it naturally by then.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge — the door leads directly into the plane. (You can also walk in through the terminal, but the airfield route is faster.) Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is a little delayed, so keep flying until it unlocks.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy military response on the way in, so bring armor and a fast approach vehicle.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — How to Get Military Tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies themselves, which appear as green icons in unfogged map areas. Then break into a jewelry store through its back door with the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping. When you reach a locked door you get the choice: kick it (which triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. It starts with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest, pay Yasmani the fence (unlocked in Chapter 3) for security-van tips — $10,000 each, after you have done his earlier Payday Loans quests — and he marks the vans with a purple icon for you to follow. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Every vault robbery triggers an instant 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle to cut through traffic, then switch to another vehicle to become unrecognizable. A single bank can pay up to $205,000, making this the best money-maker in the endgame. PowerPyx's companion guide maps all 8 bank vault locations.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 8 Bank Vault Locations

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal, That's Where The Money Is…: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. You can also get it earlier — armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks. Block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests, and Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Either way the trophy only pops once you have escaped the red heat radius — or used a Pay 'n' Spray — so do not stop running after the grab.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it after the story, when the map is open and you have aircraft access, and combine the flight with scanning vehicles and studying animals from the air-side stops. PowerPyx's companion guide shows the fastest unfogging route and the best plane for it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — How to Unfog the Map Fast

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; for this trophy one per gang is enough, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so you will earn it automatically on the way. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right. PowerPyx's companion guide maps every operation location.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All Illegal Gang Operation Locations

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no community guide had verified the trigger when this guide was written (19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. What the description itself suggests: find a spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order or enjoy a cocktail there, and see if it pops — likely tied to a specific bar or viewpoint on the beach. Treat this as a lead, not a verified method, and check PowerPyx's guide for updates as the community pins it down.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown); EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no community guide had verified the trigger when this guide was written (19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description points at a vehicle showroom: the likely method is to drive a car through the showroom's front window on the way out, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape. Try it at a dealership showroom and see if it pops — and check PowerPyx's guide for a confirmed method as the community finds one.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown); EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the illegal gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the remaining valuables, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check each character's strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a gym membership and always train together with your partner (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while you actively work out with one character, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map, then Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it helps to turn on criminal-profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) — a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. Your profile shifts with how you play: Professional for stealthy objectives and clean escapes, Hardened for incapacitating enemies without killing them, Violent for killing enemies and civilians, Psycho for killing large numbers of cops and civilians or driving over gravestones — and Irredeemable is a permanent status from excessive violence, best avoided since cops will shoot on sight more often. This comes passively while you work on every other trophy and the 100% checklist; if it is still short at the end, farm it quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — Criminal Profile Explained

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no community guide had verified the trigger when this guide was written (19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and the community's best guess ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue: the description (second time's the charm) suggests failing something there once, then succeeding on the second try. Treat that as an unconfirmed lead, not a method, and check PowerPyx's guide for updates.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown); EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no community guide had verified the trigger when this guide was written (19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and the community's best guess ties it to a UFO questline. If the game hides a UFO encounter the way past GTA games did, it will be a specific place and time — but no location has been verified yet, so do not go hunting on a guess. Check PowerPyx's guide for the confirmed method as the community finds it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown); EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no community guide had verified the trigger when this guide was written (19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and the community's best guess is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. Try knocking enemies down with a melee attack from a moving bike and see if it pops; treat that as an unconfirmed lead and check PowerPyx's guide for the confirmed method.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown); EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not a single haul, and it comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist — the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in one robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The shops around Leonida include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. This comes naturally if you gear up properly for the robberies and the shooting ranges, so do not force it early — check your spending near the end and top it up with a car mod or two.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. The quickest way to the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Buy the garages early and On the Spot becomes possible, since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PowerPyx — All 12 Garage Locations

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots — so buy the garages for Little Boxes before you start. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, open his garage menu and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
